name: Table
label: Table
description: Data table with flexible cell content, striped rows, compact sizing, and support for icons, inputs, buttons, and interactive controls.

props.name: bordered
props.description:
Adds an outer border + border-radius container, a tinted thead background,
and `--color-divider` row lines — matching the bordered table style used on
markdown content pages.

props.name: columnDividers
props.description: Draws a vertical line between columns, as well as the lines between rows.

props.name: captionHidden
props.description: Whether to visually hide the caption (still available to screen readers)
